**Text.** Tristan Needham, *Visual Complex Analysis*.

**Mode.** Friday parallel track. Chs 1–5 to start (geometry of complex functions, Möbius transformations, differentiation as amplitwist).

**Why.** Keeps the geometric instinct alive while the primary phase is heads-down on proofs. Needham is the manifesto for intuition-over-symbol-pushing; perfect Friday material.
